title: Bodhon, Amantran & Adhivas
description: Evening ritual awakening the goddess; traditionally observed at bonedi bari household pujas such as the Shobhabazar Rajbari.

title: Nabapatrika Snan (Kola Bou bathing)
description: Dawn ritual of bathing the nine-plant Nabapatrika (Kola Bou) in the Ganga, followed by procession to the pandal. A classic North Kolkata Saptami sight.
source: Typical recurring Puja event; exact timing and venue to be confirmed with the organisers

title: Kumari Puja
description: Ritual worship of a young girl as the goddess, famously performed at Belur Math (Howrah side) on Ashtami. Arrive early; entry may be regulated.
source: Typical recurring Puja event; exact timing and venue to be confirmed with the organisers

title: Sandhi Puja
description: The holy junction of Ashtami and Navami. The exact muhurta is set by the panjika each year and differs by committee, so time shown is a placeholder.
